literal_source_claim_en: A lower bound for subset sums over a finite field.

candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For a prime p and nonempty finite subsets A and B of Z/pZ, the sumset A+B has cardinality at least min(p, |A|+|B|-1).
statement_blocker: The catalog gives only 'a lower bound for subset sums over a finite field'. It does not state two input sets, prime modulus, nonemptiness, sumset semantics, cardinal encoding, capped formula, subtraction convention, or boundary cases. An arbitrary finite-field version capped by field cardinality is false for extension fields with proper additive subgroups, while the conventional theorem is over Z/pZ and a valid group/finite-field generalization caps by minimal nontrivial element order/characteristic. No catalog-cited primary edition, exact premise/proof/errata map, source-adoption decision, or independent review is admitted. Selecting ZMod.cauchy_davenport now would add proposition-changing mathematics without accepted source authority.
